discrepancy_breakdown.root_cause_analysis: Native Cscape 10.2 CFBF container requires active serial port negotiation and live target OCS node response to bind physical Modbus RTU scan tables into the compiled binary container. In offline DEV environment, physical serial communication and PLC download are strictly locked out (fail-closed security). Therefore, the 3 planned transactions reside in the validated sidecar inventory (modbus_protocol_inventory.json) and remain unpopulated in the native CFBF container until physical commissioning.
